name: Sister Boniface Mysteries
description: First there was Father Brown. Now, say hello to Sister Boniface. This clever, moped-riding nun is the police's secret weapon for solving murders in this divine Father Brown spin-off.

videos.title: Christmas Special : The Star of the Orient
videos.overview: It’s Christmas and Britain is in the grips of the worst winter on record. When a precious jewel is stolen from a snowbound train, the crime-solving nun uncovers murder, ancient curses and dark family secrets.

videos.title: Christmas Special 2024 : Once Upon a Time Part One
videos.overview: Sister Boniface investigates when the Christmas production of Cinderella turns into the pantomime of death.

videos.title: Christmas Special 2024 : Once Upon a Time Part Two
videos.overview: The sleuthing nun continues her investigation into the murder of a member of the amateur dramatics society.

videos.title: Unnatural Causes
videos.overview: The discovery of a housemaid's corpse at a local festival puts a damper on Great Slaughter's jovial gathering.

videos.title: Lights, Camera, Murder!
videos.overview: And...action! On a movie set, the drama really starts when what was thought to be a prop gun turns out to be a real .38 caliber.

videos.title: Love and Other Puzzles
videos.overview: After spending the night with a pipe-smoking gentleman caller, a woman is found dead with a jigsaw puzzle and a face full of cold cream.

videos.title: My Brother's Keeper
videos.overview: Sister Reginald's ex-con brother Alfie abruptly shows up at the convent after being released from jail. With nowhere to go, the sisters agree to let him stay. But when a well-known artist is found murdered, Alfie begins to look like the prime suspect.

videos.title: Scoop!
videos.overview: The body of a high-level government official's secretary is found at the bottom of a staircase - and Sister Boniface claims she was dead before the fall.

videos.title: Song for the Dead
videos.overview: The dreamy frontman of buzzy rock'n'roll band The Queenmakers is found dead in the dressing room, just as they are about to go on for their set. Upon inspection, Sister Boniface finds a peculiar sting on the back of his neck.

videos.title: Dem Bones
videos.overview: Great Slaughter's annual giant marrow contest is interrupted when a dog digs up some seemingly ancient bones on the site. Is it the archeological discovery of a lifetime? Or is it murder?

videos.title: Queen of the Kitchen
videos.overview: Celebrity housewife Prunella Gladwell arrives in Great Slaughter to film a feisty baking competition, and one of the contestants is about to hit her expiration date.

videos.title: Sister Town
videos.overview: When a German mayor makes a visit to Great Slaughter to partake in a war memorial ceremony, tragedy strikes. Was it a terrible accident or a malicious plan?

videos.title: Crimes and Miss Demeanours
videos.overview: The Miss United contest takes a dive when one of the beauty queens is discovered dead in the pool - and it's not a pretty sight.

videos.title: Don't Try This at Home
videos.overview: Great Slaughter plays host to the summer roadshow of kids’ TV show ‘Jolly Roger’, much to the annoyance of editor Dinah Morgan. Timbers are soon shivered however when Dinah is discovered smothered onset during a live show. Sister Boniface is called in to investigate who could have committed the deed.

videos.title: The Shadow of Baron Battenberg
videos.overview: A sighting of the mysteriously missing Baron Battenberg sends the press and police into a frenzy. Determined to uncover the facts, Ruth and Sam go undercover at the Pranayama retreat, run by the Baron’s widow Marion Grey and brother Edwin Battenberg.

videos.title: The It Girl
videos.overview: Peggy is delighted when an old school friend and supermodel Robin returns home to film a documentary but all goes awry once Max Savage, Robin's manager, is found dead locked in his bedroom.

videos.title: The Book of Shadows
videos.overview: Sister Boniface and the gang are horrified to discover all the hallmarks of a ritualistic human sacrifice in the woods, supposedly acted out by a coven of witches!

videos.title: St George's Defence
videos.overview: Convinced that events catastrophic to the Cold War are being planned at the British Open Chess Championships, Sister Boniface must brush off her chess skills and join the tournament.

videos.title: A Tight Squeeze
videos.overview: Felix is a Police Advisor on set of the latest 'Oh! Do Behave!' picture. Felix is soon called to action once the abrasive direction Sexton St Juste is found strangled

videos.title: Stiff Competition
videos.overview: Great Slaughter is buzzing with excitement for this year’s talent show! The excitement turns to panic once a magician is murdered due to a trick.

videos.title: Dead Air
videos.overview: A new trendy radio station comes to Great Slaughter but soon there is only static once a host is murdered on the air.

videos.title: Stage Fright
videos.overview: Great Slaughter's Amateur Dramatic Society's upcoming production turns from drama to disaster once the leading actor is killed by the leading actress.

videos.title: The Good Samaritan
videos.overview: When a local resident is found murdered in a method matching that of "The Good Samaritan" killer, Sister Boniface fears the killer is back.

videos.title: Never Too Deadly to Die
videos.overview: Sister Boniface is shaken and stirred when one of the screen-testing stars for the new Agent Best film is murdered.

videos.title: The House of Misfit Dolls
videos.overview: Sister Boniface finds herself on the hunt for a killer doll when a local toymaker is discovered stabbed to death in a locked room.

videos.title: Professor Y
videos.overview: When a 'Professor Y' convention descends on the village, Sister Boniface finds herself investigating the mysterious disappearance of the show's creator.

videos.title: A Fragrant Scandal
videos.overview: When the Head Nose of a famous fragrance dynasty is found slain in his study, Sister Boniface must sniff out a killer.

videos.title: How to Murder a Tune
videos.overview: Sister Boniface investigates when TV show Glory Be arrives at St Vincent’s and the battle to win chorister of the year turns deadly.

videos.title: It's Just Not Cricket
videos.overview: When Great Slaughter Cricket Club’s arrogant star player is murdered, Sister Boniface must do all she can to catch the killer.

videos.title: A Beautiful World
videos.overview: Mrs Clam goes undercover when glamourous door-to-door saleswomen arrive in Great Slaughter, bringing makeovers and murder with them.

videos.title: Toast to the Newly Dead
videos.overview: Felix’s wedding fast approaches but can Sister Boniface unveil the killer in the wedding party before the big day?

videos.title: Biff! Pow! Zap!
videos.overview: Sister Boniface investigates a sabotaged stunt when the lead actress in TV show “Foxman” plummets to her death.

videos.title: A Murder of Crows
videos.overview: Sister Boniface investigates when a killer scarecrow wreaks havoc at the annual Scarecrow Festival.

videos.title: Are Ye’ Dancin’?
videos.overview: When a member of a ceilidh band is slain Sister Boniface must catch the killer at Mrs Clam’s birthday party.

videos.title: Killer Heels
videos.overview: Sister Boniface must tread carefully when the owner of the local shoe factory is found murdered.

videos.title: Let the Games Begin!
videos.overview: Sister Boniface investigates when a bucking bronco goes haywire on the set of a hit TV game show.

videos.title: There's No "I" In Slaughter
videos.overview: When a police team-building trip takes a sinister turn Sister Boniface must discover which of their rivals is a murderer.

videos.title: The Happiest Family
videos.overview: Sister Boniface investigates when the nuns’ wholesome weekend away is overshadowed by hedonists and murder.

videos.title: And Then There Were Nun
videos.overview: Can Sister Boniface catch the killer of a fellow nun before she leaves Great Slaughter for good?
